caption:
Beauty and wellness businesses often carry significant fit-out and equipment costs relative to their size, alongside appointment-driven revenue. Finance can support opening, upgrading, or expanding treatment spaces without a large upfront cash outlay.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs — understanding beauty and wellness businesses's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Fit-out and specialised equipment tend to be the biggest upfront costs in beauty and wellness businesses.
